selection_policy: AVG64 remains final, chosen a priori; loss comparison does not tune weights/rank or use formal benchmark outcomes.
evaluation_only: Single SwiftSft.train hook calls Trainer.evaluate; flags do_train=false/do_eval=true, prediction_loss_only=true, predict_with_generate=false; parameters frozen, no optimizer/scheduler/steps/checkpoint weights.
dataset_field_note: Native SftArguments requires nonempty dataset even in evaluation-only. Both dataset and val_dataset point at the same unchanged249-row existing val file; the train hook never reads it for optimization.
metric: Native Swift/Trainer eval_loss on identical249 rows at batch1; not claimed as a custom globally token-weighted NLL.
domain_loss: Omitted in this minimal pass to avoid extra forwards or changing native metric collection; source domain counts retained.
scope: Existing SFT validation loss only. No task-level validation benchmark, answer generation, judge calls or new validation data.
